description.zh: 输入任一命题，通过第一性原理、反向拆解、极端压力测试与决策边界四重视角，层层剥离认知盲区。
description.en: Input any proposition and dismantle cognitive blind spots through First-Principles, Deconstruction, Stress-Testing, and Decision Boundaries.

releaseNotes.zh: ThinkPrism 多维思辨透镜首发版本发布。内置第一性原理、反向拆解、极端压力测试与决策边界四维认知透镜，支持流式并发推演、实时进度条、Markdown 与 JSON 双格式导出及本地优先决策档案库。
releaseNotes.en: Initial release of ThinkPrism. Features 4 cognitive lenses (First Principles, Deconstruction, Stress Test, Decision Boundary), streaming inference, dual Markdown/JSON export, and local-first archives.
